overview: Sha by Aenset is a mobile-first PWA personal assistant with 7 tabs: Home, Notes, Planner, Finance, Profile, Wardrobe, and Gym. Features smart planning, structured notes, a finance tracker with budget limits, wardrobe and outfit planning, gym tracking, and a detailed weather widget. All data persists to ICP backend and syncs across devices.
features: Blank screen fix with error boundary and defensive startup
Weekly 7-day weather summary card on Home
Currency preference saved to ICP backend for cross-device sync
Budget limits with spending alerts in Finance
Live clock with 12/24-hour toggle and millisecond stopwatch
Enhanced weather widget with pollen, UV, wind, humidity, sunrise/sunset
Planner with notifications 10 min before tasks
Gym tracker with weekly schedule and progress heatmap
Wardrobe with outfit builder and planner integration
Multi-language support (14 languages, RTL for Arabic)
